title: S&P 500 CAPE Ratio Topped 40, a Level Seen Only Twice Before
summary: The S&P 500 Shiller CAPE ratio rose above 40 in 2026 for only the third time on record, after the dot-com era and early 2022. Here is what the data show.
body_markdown:
Episode CAPE above 40 Index peak What followed


Dot-com Jan. 1999 to Sept. 2000 (high of 44.2 in Dec. 1999) 1,527 close on March 24, 2000 Down 49% by Oct. 9, 2002


Early 2022 Passed 40 by Jan. 2022 About 4,796 on Jan. 3, 2022 Down about 25% by Oct. 2022


2026 Above 40 since May 2026 None identified Unresolved


*Source: The Motley Fool, Nov. 17, 2026, with CAPE data credited to YCharts.*


## Excess CAPE Yield at Lowest Since March 2002


A related Shiller measure also sits at a level last seen more than two decades ago. The excess CAPE yield, which subtracts the real 10-year Treasury yield from the index's cyclically adjusted earnings yield, was 0.56 percentage points in October 2026, the lowest since March 2002, the same Trading Tools report showed.


From that March 2002 reading, the index's monthly average fell another 27% to its February 2003 low, the report added. It also noted that the daily real 10-year yield closed Oct. 30 at 2.60%, after a 2026 high of 2.95% on Oct. 5 that was the highest since November 2008.


## AI Spending Behind the Rally Since ChatGPT


The Motley Fool report tied the current stretch to artificial intelligence, saying investors have rewarded companies that benefit from AI infrastructure spending. Since ChatGPT launched in late November 2022, the index has gained 85%, the Nasdaq Composite 119% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average 51%, the same report said.


Spatacco also wrote that the CAPE has never reliably provided a timetable for corrections. Because the ratio is calculated on the whole index, it also describes the holdings of[funds built to track the S&P 500](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/sp-500-etf-explained-how-voo-ivv-and-spy-differ/) , such as the[SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/spy/) ,[Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/voo/) and[iShares Core S&P 500 ETF (IVV)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/ivv/) .
